"Kestrel Vance"
Kestrel Vance (born 1974) is an engineer from Duskhaven, best known for inventing the Solvane Engine in 1999. Vance studied mechanical systems at the Meridian Institute before founding an independent workshop. Vance's early work focused on compact power cells, which later became the basis for the Solvane Engine design.

"Solvane Engine"
The Solvane Engine is a compact power engine invented by Kestrel Vance in 1999. It was the first engine of its kind to combine a sealed power cell with a rotary drive shaft, reducing fuel consumption by nearly a third compared to earlier designs. The engine was widely adopted in freight vehicles across the Ashmere Republic during the early 2000s.

"Duskhaven"
Duskhaven is a city and the capital of the Ashmere Republic. Founded in the 1700s as a trading post, it grew into an industrial center known for engineering and manufacturing. Duskhaven is the birthplace of several notable inventors, including Kestrel Vance and the novelist Orlen Hask.

"Ashmere Republic"
The Ashmere Republic is a nation whose capital city is Duskhaven. It is known for its engineering industry and its network of rail lines connecting coastal towns to the capital. The republic's economy grew rapidly after the introduction of the Solvane Engine in local manufacturing.

"Talia Nord"
Talia Nord is an astronomer affiliated with the Meridian Institute. In 2031, she discovered the planet Virel Prime while surveying the Corvexa star system. Nord later led the Institute's deep-sky observation program and published several papers on planetary formation.

"Virel Prime"
Virel Prime is a planet orbiting the star Corvexa. It was discovered in 2031 by astronomer Talia Nord during a survey of the Corvexa system. Virel Prime is notable for its dense ring structure, which was first photographed by the Meridian Institute's orbital telescope in 2033.

"Corvexa"
Corvexa is a star located in the outer survey field studied by the Meridian Institute. It hosts several planets, including Virel Prime, which was discovered orbiting it in 2031. Corvexa is smaller and dimmer than the Sun, classified as an orange dwarf.

"Meridian Institute"
The Meridian Institute is a research organization known for its programs in engineering and astronomy. Notable affiliates include the astronomer Talia Nord, who discovered Virel Prime while working there, and engineer Kestrel Vance, who studied mechanical systems at the Institute before inventing the Solvane Engine.

"Orlen Hask"
Orlen Hask is a novelist born in Duskhaven. Hask is best known for the 1998 novel The Glass Meridian, which won the Ashmere Literary Prize the following year. Before becoming a full-time writer, Hask worked as a rail dispatcher on the Vantage Rail Line.

"The Glass Meridian"
The Glass Meridian is a 1998 novel written by Orlen Hask. Set in a fictionalized version of Duskhaven, it follows a rail dispatcher who uncovers a conspiracy involving the city's engineering guilds. The novel won the Ashmere Literary Prize in 1999.

"Basalt Coast"
Basalt Coast is a coastal region known for its dark volcanic cliffs and fishing villages. It lies south of Duskhaven and is a popular destination for hikers. The region's economy depends mainly on fishing and small-scale tourism.

"Fennimore Trading Co."
Fennimore Trading Co. is a historic trading company founded in the 1820s. It operated a chain of warehouses along the Ashmere coastline before closing its last branch in the 1960s. Its former headquarters building still stands in Basalt Coast.

"Iron Larkspur Festival"
The Iron Larkspur Festival is an annual autumn festival celebrated in several towns across the Ashmere Republic. It features metalworking competitions and traditional music, and traces its origins to a 19th-century blacksmiths' guild gathering.

"Colwick Bridge"
Colwick Bridge is a stone bridge crossing the Northfen Marsh. Built in 1889, it was for many years the only crossing connecting Duskhaven to the eastern farmlands. The bridge is now a protected historic landmark.

"Northfen Marsh"
Northfen Marsh is a wetland region east of Duskhaven, crossed by Colwick Bridge. The marsh is a protected habitat for migratory birds and is monitored by a small research station affiliated with the Meridian Institute.

"Vantage Rail Line"
The Vantage Rail Line is a railway connecting Duskhaven to the towns along Basalt Coast. Construction began in 1911 and the line was completed in 1917. It was one of the first rail lines in the Ashmere Republic to use Solvane Engine locomotives after their introduction.

"Vantage Rail Line"
Among the Vantage Rail Line's former employees was Orlen Hask, who worked as a dispatcher before publishing The Glass Meridian in 1998. The line remains in operation today, carrying both freight and passengers between Duskhaven and the coastal towns.

"Thistledown Choir"
The Thistledown Choir is a community choir based in Duskhaven, founded in 1952. It performs annually at the Iron Larkspur Festival and has released several recordings of traditional Ashmere folk songs.

"Braxel Mining Guild"
The Braxel Mining Guild is a historic organization that once controlled most of the mineral extraction in the Ashmere Republic. It was dissolved in 1974 after the industry was nationalized by the republic's government.
